next.user: The scorer no longer resizes the active player's card and fonts mid-game — the active player is highlighted with green (and the play icon) at normal size.
next.what: On the live match scoreboard, the active player's name and score used to jump to much larger font sizes when it was their turn. That size bump is removed; the active player is now marked only by the green color and the play icon, so the layout stays stable between turns.
next.why: The size change made cards and text visibly resize every turn, causing layout jitter on the scoreboard. Color-only highlighting keeps the same emphasis with a calmer, stable layout.
next.next: Start or watch a live match — the active player now stands out by green color only, with no layout shifting.

next.user: New gotcha documented: wiki-recap's staged docs can sneak into your next commit — check `git status` or commit with explicit paths.
next.why: Future commits should contain only what was intended; this explains the mixed commit `a71bd6c` and how to avoid repeating it.
next.next: Read docs/wiki/learnings/wiki-recap-staged-files-sweep-into-the-next-commit.md before your next commit.
next.summary: Recorded a new learning: the wiki-recap subagent leaves docs/wiki/ files staged in the git index, so `git add <file>` + commit sweeps them into unrelated commits (observed in `a71bd6c`, which bundled ~40 wiki files with the PlayerPanel fix). Mitigation: `git status` before committing, unstage docs/wiki, or use `git commit -- <paths>`.
